title: Fox Power Converter
description: Converts EU energy to RF energy quickly and reliably
body:
# Fox Power Converter

***

## ⚡ Designed for technology-focused modpacks!

Fox Power Converter is a simple but powerful utility mod that allows seamless conversion of EU energy into RF energy for maximum compatibility between your favorite tech mods.

> Connect IndustrialCraft power networks to RF-based machines without complicated setups.

## ⚡ What does this mod add?

🔌 Fast EU → RF energy conversion  
Convert IndustrialCraft EU energy directly into RF with high efficiency.

⚙️ Stable and reliable power transfer  
Designed to handle continuous energy flow without unnecessary complexity.

🏭 Better mod compatibility  
Use EU generators to power RF machines from other technology mods.

🔄 Simple integration  
Easy to use, easy to automate, and perfect for large-scale factories.

## 😏 Why use it?

✔️ Because your machines deserve more power  
✔️ Because EU and RF should work together  
✔️ Because automation is easier with one shared energy system  
✔️ Because efficiency matters

## 🧪 Who is this mod for?

*   ⚡ IndustrialCraft players
    
*   🏭 Factory builders
    
*   🔧 Tech modpack creators
    
*   🚀 Automation enthusiasts
    

## ⚠️ Requirements

*   Minecraft 1.7.10 (Forge)
    
*   IndustrialCraft²
    
*   A mod that uses RF energy
